data_fields.name: track_pick
data_fields.donor_constant: random choice from the trigger list (distribution not read)

best_idea: Keep a data table from trigger name to a pick-one list, run each layer on its own repeat timer scheduled from the previous due time, and fade the bed before a stinger instead of cutting it.
decision_why: Trigger tables and independent layer timers suit zone beds as data, but the donor has no biome beds, no crossfade and no voice limit, so the bed fade, the voice cap and the finish-event cleanup must be added before use.
acceptance: A death or victory stinger fades the zone bed over 300 ms as the cue plays; the nature bed comes back on its own 3-minute timer without drift; no more than 32 sound voices play at once, and music is the last voice dropped.
